stem: One of these fragments is chosen at random from those that did not survive. What is the probability that it was transplanted on the deep reef?
stimulus:
Marine biologists transplanted coral fragments onto two reef zones and recorded whether each fragment survived one year.

Decimal form of the reversed fraction 36/90.
